title: A Bottle of Dew
introduction: The learning package for A Bottle of Dew uses the chapter's themes such as A Bottle of Dew, observation, reasoning, application, evidence, reflection. Learners read or listen closely, infer meaning, discuss choices, use evidence from the chapter, and connect the learning with their own lives.
